name: EchoRewards – Refer a Friend Rewards Program for WooCommerce
author: WPPOOL

sections.description:
Website | Documentation | Tutorials | Live Demo

Create your customer referral program with a refer-a-friend plugin for WordPress. With EchoRewards, automate customer rewards and add a refer-a-friend program to your WooCommerce store.

Let’s grow, connect, and thrive together!

  • 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community
  • 🌐 Follow Us on X (Twitter)
  • 🎥 Subscribe on YouTube
  • 👍 Like Our Facebook Page

🎉 Unlock the Magic of Mutual Discounts 🎉

With EchoRewards, your customers can share coupons with their friends and family. When someone redeems a coupon, the recipient receives a discount, and the person who shared it can also be rewarded.

This approach helps turn customers into advocates and can increase customer acquisition.

EchoRewards Refer a Friend Plugin Helps you Achieve:

  • Increased Customer Acquisition: People are more likely to try a new product or service when recommended by someone they trust. This WooCommerce coupon plugin enables customer-to-customer referrals.
  • Reduced Marketing Costs: Customer referrals can reduce the cost of acquiring new customers compared to some advertising channels.
  • Enhanced Customer Loyalty: Offering referral rewards shows appreciation, which may increase customer retention.
  • Trackable Marketing: Track which customers provide referrals and which channels perform best.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

😃 EchoRewards Free Features

  • 👥 Unlimited Referral Coupons: Every customer gets a unique referral coupon to share with friends, family, and social networks. When the coupon is used, both the referrer and the friend can receive a discount.

  • 🔗 Referral Links: Each customer receives a unique referral link to share across their network. When someone uses this link to reach the cart page, the discount can be applied automatically—no manual code entry.

  • 💳 Customize Discount Type: Choose from percentage discounts or fixed amounts.

  • 👥 Referrer Status Customization: Decide which customers are eligible for the referral program. If enabled, the referrer must have at least one order before referring others.

  • 🔒 Discount Capping: Control discounts by setting a cap to keep your program within budget.

  • 🔍 Include/Exclude Products & Categories: Include or exclude specific products or categories.

  • 💰 Set Minimum Purchase Amount: Set a minimum purchase amount to qualify for a referral coupon.

  • 🧑‍💻 Shortcode Support: Place EchoRewards components (referral card, email invitation card, reward coupon table, and invitation tracking table) anywhere on your site with a shortcode.

  • 📊 Advanced Reporting & Analytics: Get 7 days of referral program analytics and insights to understand program effectiveness and identify active referrers.

  • 💰 Discount Amount Customization: Customize the discount amount for referrers and referees.

  • 🛒 Referral Program Tab on WooCommerce: Enable a Referral Program tab so customers can learn about the program and sign up.

  • 📩 Email Notifications: Referrers can receive email notifications containing reward coupons when a friend completes an order with a referral coupon.

  • 🔍 Invitation Tracking: Referrers can track the progress of their shared coupon from the “My Account” page.

  • 📱 Social Sharing: Share referral coupons through Facebook, X (Twitter), and WhatsApp.

  • 📨 Email Invitation: Share referral codes via email.

  • 📊 Intuitive Admin Dashboard: Use a dashboard to configure program settings including program status and discount amounts.

  • 💻 Multisite Supported: EchoRewards supports WordPress multisite networks.

  • 📋Referrer Insights: View referrer name and email on order details for orders using referral coupons.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

👑 EchoRewards Pro Features

  • 💳 Customize Reward Points: Offer reward points to motivate referrals.

  • 🎈 Floating Referral Widget: Notify site visitors about your referral program with a floating widget that can help increase participation.

  • 🔄 Recurring Subscription Rewards: Use recurring referral and reward coupons with WooCommerce Subscriptions so discounts can apply directly to active, or new subscriptions via My Account > Subscriptions.

  • 🎛️ Reward Management Dashboard: Manage all referrers, view active advocates, track total sales driven, and inspect individual referral histories with direct WooCommerce order verification.

  • 🎯 Per-Customer Rule & Reward Customization: Override global rules for specific advocates to assign custom reward percentages, point rates, cap limits, or custom welcome discounts for people using their code.

  • 🎁 Manual Reward & Point Issuance: Directly issue one-off reward coupons or points to any customer profile outside the standard referral flow for loyalty campaigns or compensation.

  • 🛠️ Gutenberg Block & Elementor Referral Widget: Place the referral card, email invitation card, reward coupon table, and invitation tracking table anywhere with Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets.

  • 🌪️ Funnel Integration: EchoRewards integrates with FunnelKit, WPFunnels, and many funnel plugins that support Gutenberg and Elementor widgets.

  • 🏷️ Referral Coupon Prefix: Add a coupon prefix for your referral program.

  • 🛍️ Restrict Coupons for Specific Products: Choose the products where coupons can be redeemed.

  • 📧 Customize Rewards Email: Customize reward email subject, heading, and description from plugin settings.

  • 🌐 Extended Social Sharing Options: Allow sharing across up to 14 social networks.

  • 🧑‍💻 Shortcode Support: Place the Rewards Points table on your site with a shortcode.

  • 📊 Advanced Reporting & Analytics: Monitor referral statistics such as active referrers, new customer acquisition, and revenue attributed to referrals.

  • 🔏 Coupon Privacy: Choose whether only logged-in customers or all customers can apply referral coupons during purchase.

  • ⌛ Reward Coupon Validity: Set how long reward coupons remain valid.

  • 🔒 Referral Access Control: Restrict referral coupon and link usage to logged-in customers to help prevent misuse.

  • 📧 Dynamic Email Tags: Personalize referral emails with dynamic tags (e.g., Referrer Name, Referral Discount).

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

⚡ Grow Your Referral Program with the Floating Referral Widget

The Floating Referral Widget keeps your referral program in front of every visitor as they browse your store. Instead of customers having to find the referral program tab, the widget surfaces it automatically, increasing referral participation without any extra effort from you.

Pair it with EchoRewards’ referral analytics to track which customers are driving referrals, which reward types convert best, and where your referral program can grow.

💎 Granular Reward Management & Customer-Level Customization

Take complete control of your referral program with the built-in Reward Management Dashboard. Track top-performing advocates, analyze total sales driven, and verify referral orders directly within WooCommerce using real-time analytics and detailed referral histories.
Tailor your incentives beyond one-size-fits-all settings. Override global rules to offer custom reward rates, assign exclusive welcome discounts to top ambassador codes, or manually issue reward coupons and points to individual customer accounts.
Elevate your WooCommerce store’s referral program, support customer engagement, and track results with EchoRewards.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

🔥 More Awesome Plugins

If you like EchoReward, then consider checking out our other awesome projects:

  • 🔄 FlexStock – Stock Sync with Google Sheet for WooCommerce – Auto-sync WooCommerce products from Google Sheets. Flex Stock is an easy, powerful, and simple inventory management system to handle your WooCommerce products.

  • 🛒 FlexOrder – Order Sync with Google Sheet for WooCommerce – Manage WooCommerce orders from Google Sheets. WooCommerce order sync, e-commerce order management, and sales order management with Google Sheets by our Flex Order.

  • 🟢 FlexTable – Sheets To WP Table Live Sync – Google Sheets allows you to input data on your Google sheet and show the same data on WordPress as a table effortlessly. Try Flex Table now!

  • 📽️ Webinar & Video Conference with Jitsi Meet – WordPress video conference plugin and live video chat solution. Get shortcode support with WooCommerce and BuddyPress integration.

  • 📝 FormyChat – Send contact form leads to WhatsApp chat. This WhatsApp notification plugin makes it easy to manage contact forms. Quick, easy and no coding required.

Build Instructions

The admin and frontend interfaces are built with React and compiled with webpack. The complete, uncompiled source code is included in this plugin under react-app/, and the compiled bundles are written to build/ (with accompanying .map source map files).

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services. Each is described below with what it is used for, what data is sent, and when it is sent.

Appsero (telemetry and license/update checks)

EchoRewards uses the Appsero SDK to collect optional telemetry that helps us troubleshoot problems and improve the plugin.

Appsero does not gather any data by default. Data is only collected after the site administrator explicitly opts in through the admin notice. When opted in, it sends the site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, the plugin version and active/inactive plugin and theme information, and the administrator’s name and email address. Data is sent when the plugin is activated or deactivated, and periodically thereafter.

Service provided by Appsero: privacy policy.

icanhazip.com (IP address lookup)

As part of the optional Appsero telemetry described above, the site’s public IP address is looked up through icanhazip.com. No data about your site or its visitors is transmitted to this service; the request only returns the IP address of the server making it. This request is only made when telemetry has been enabled by the administrator.

Service provided by icanhazip.com: terms of service and privacy policy.

WPPOOL newsletter and CRM (fluent.wppool.dev)

If the site administrator opts in through the admin notice, the administrator’s name and email address are sent to WPPOOL’s own CRM so we can send product updates and onboarding emails. Nothing is sent unless the administrator opts in.

Service provided by WPPOOL: terms of service, privacy policy.

QR Server (QR codes for WeChat sharing)

When the referral sharing options include WeChat, the plugin displays a QR code image generated by the QR Server API. The referral link or referral coupon message being shared is sent to api.qrserver.com as part of the image URL so the QR code can be generated. This happens when a customer views the referral sharing options with WeChat enabled. If you do not enable WeChat as a sharing platform, no request is made to this service.

Service provided by QR Server: terms of service and privacy policy.

Privacy Policy

EchoReward uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to WordPress Dashboard>Plugins>Add New. Search “Echo Rewards” and activate the plugin.
  2. Make sure that WooCommerce is installed and activated on your site.
  3. Access the plugin settings from Marketing>EchoReward.
  4. Update your referral and reward settings and begin your referral program journey!

Learn more about how Echo Reward works through our overview video.
sections.faq:
How does the WooCommerce referral system work in EchoRewards?

Each customer gets a unique referral coupon and referral link. When someone uses that link or coupon to make a purchase, EchoRewards automatically tracks the referral and issues reward coupons or reward points to the referrer. The referral and reward process is fully automated.

Do I need coding knowledge to set up a referral program?

No. EchoRewards is built for store owners, not developers. Install, configure your referral discount amounts, and your referral program is live.

Can I reward both the referrer and the referred friend?

Yes. EchoRewards lets you set separate reward amounts for the referrer and the friend. Most WooCommerce referral plugins only reward one side.

What types of rewards can I offer in a referral program?

The free version supports percentage and fixed amount referral coupons. The Pro version also supports reward points, custom reward logic per customer, and recurring rewards for WooCommerce Subscriptions.

Can I control which customers participate in the referral program?

Yes. You can require customers to have at least one completed order before they can refer others. Pro users can also customize referral and reward logic individually per customer, giving full control over who earns what.

Where do I get support?

Use the official WordPress support forum to report issues.

2.6.12 – 07 Oct 2026

  • New: Added a “Referral coupon or link for new customers only” setting to restrict referrals to customers with no previous orders, checked by account and billing email.
  • Fix: Fixed referral discounts being removed when customers retry checkout after a failed payment.

2.6.11 – 29 Sep 2026

  • Fix: Fixed a 404 error on the My Account referral page for fresh installs when the referral settings hadn’t been saved yet.
  • Improvement: Reduced duplicate AJAX requests when multiple EchoRewards shortcodes/widgets appear on the same page, improving load time for the Rewards section.
  • Compatibility: Enhanced compatibility to support WordPress 7.1.

2.6.10 – 23 Aug 2026

  • Improvement: Maintenance and security updates

2.6.9 – 09 Aug 2026

  • Improvement: Maintenance and security updates

2.6.8 – 02 Aug 2026

  • New: Customers can now apply earned recurring rewards to active subscriptions from My Account > Subscriptions, with discounts applied to the next renewal.
  • New: Recurring reward emails now include a direct link to My Account > Subscriptions for quick reward redemption.
  • Improvement: Enhanced batch data fetching for the Rewards, Invitees, and Referrals tables, as well as coupon cards, for faster and more efficient loading.

2.6.7 – 12 Jul 2026

  • Fix: Fixed a blank My Account referral page issue when using special characters in the custom Referral menu name.

2.6.6 – 30 Jun 2026

  • Fix: Fixed referral coupon card displaying fixed amount instead of percentage symbol when coupon type is set to “Sign Up Fee % Discount” or “Recurring Product % Discount”.

2.6.5 – 24 Jun 2026

  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and enhancements.

2.6.4 – 03 Jun 2026

  • Improvement: Enhanced compatibility to support WordPress 7.0.

2.6.3 – 18 May 2026

  • Fix: Fixed WooCommerce Subscriptions integration compatibility issues.

2.6.2 – 01 Apr 2026

  • Improvement: Added multilingual support with native translations

2.6.1 – 24 Feb 2026

  • Fix: Resolved a critical fatal error in WooCommerce Block Checkout.
  • Fix: Corrected an issue where the rewards discount amount was not displaying properly.
  • Fix: Improved frontend data update performance to prevent delays in reflecting changes.
  • Fix: Fixed an issue preventing the “Sign Up Discount” popup from displaying and functioning correctly.
  • Fix: Ensured the “Total Discount” tab consistently displays values with two decimal places and the correct currency symbol.
  • Fix: Restored missing currency symbols in the Reports and Analytics sections.

2.6.0 – 04 Jan 2026

  • New: Added a centralized view to manage all referrers, their referrals, and earned rewards
  • New: Introduced customer-level customization for referral rules
  • New: Enabled per-customer reward customization
  • New: Added support for offering custom reward coupons or points to specific customers
  • Improvement: Replaced ID selectors with class-based selectors to support multiple instances
  • Improvement: Added status management for individual reward types
  • Improvement: Currency symbols now respect WooCommerce currency position settings
  • Fix: Prevented guest users from applying reward coupons
  • Fix: Corrected reward expiry handling so no expiry date is set when expiry is disabled
  • Fix: Fixed an issue where the Pro label was not displayed for subscription coupons

2.5.9 – 24 Nov 2025

  • Improvement: Regular update & maintenance release

2.5.8 – 09 Nov 2025

  • Improvement: Regular maintenance update

2.5.7 – 20 Jul 2025

  • Fix: Resolved an issue where the Twitter option was not displaying correctly under the Social Media Platforms feature
  • Fix: Fixed a bug where the subtotal was not calculated correctly when a purchase was made using a referral link

For older changelog entries, please see the additional changelog.txt file delivered with the plugin.
